title: Southern Stunners - Large Group Luxury
description:
DO NOT INSTANT BOOK - The pricing you see is for one 6 bedroom home.

Andrady Homes offers these TWO AMAZING HOMES also featured on Bachelorette Nashville and Andrady Homes! There are 20 Beds and 4 queen air mattresses between the two homes!  Not including sofas.

PLEASE message prior to instant booking to confirm availability and pricing!  Whether you need one or two homes, we will make sure to send the proper special offer. 
Permit numbers: CASR-201518940 AND CASR-201518941

The space
Located just two miles from downtown, 1 mile to convention center, Music Row, Vandy, and Belmont. and blocks from cool music venues, bars, and restaurants, this home is an ideal set up for large groups needing to be close to town...and for those wanting a peaceful neighborhood to get some rest! Three floors, tons of sleeping areas, & 5 full showers! Both homes are walking distance of the other, 12South, and even downtown (but it's a LONG walk :)).

Perfect set up for families.

With soaring 15 ft ceilings, the first thing you will notice is the hand carved and recently hand sanded gingerbread Victorian staircase. The house has custom trim, tile, designer touches throughout. 6! Yes six original hand carved and tile fireplaces.

Guest access
A key will be placed in the lockbox on the porch. You will receive the code the week of arrival.

Other things to note
As of August 20, 2020 Airbnb does not allow parties and events with a cap on occupancy at 16 per home.
